name: Desun Real Estate Investment Services Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Desun Real Estate Investment Services Group Co., Ltd. provides property management and commercial operations in China, working from Chengdu since 2010 and owned by Sky Donna Holding Limited. Services cover market analysis, tenant sourcing and management of shopping streets and sales offices, plus real estate agency, advertising, interior decoration and procurement. It also does brand development for commercial clients and leasing and conference services for industrial parks and offices.
